confidence.reason: The failure log directly shows an empty string received immediately after click due to missing auto-retry mechanisms on page.textContent.

finalExplanation: The test fetches the text content of '#result' immediately after clicking the button using 'page.textContent()', which does not wait for asynchronous DOM updates to finish. Because the data population occurs asynchronously after the click, the test reads an empty string before the text 'Data Loaded' is rendered.
